marked with brackets and asterisks (&#8220;[***]&#8221;), have been redacted pursuant to Item 601(b)(10)(iv) of Regulation S-K. The redacted
information is (i) not material and/or (ii) would constitute personal private information (e.g., home addresses, email addresses, passport
numbers), the disclosure of which would present a risk of competitive harm or invasion of personal privacy. An unredacted copy of this
Exhibit will be provided to the Securities and Exchange Commission upon request.</B></P>

and collectively the &quot;Parties&quot;),</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">is
hereby amended to read as follows:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>Section
IV. COMPENSATION.</B> In consideration for the Services provided, Consultants are to be paid a total of three thousand and no/100 USD
($3,000.00) per month <U>through the 31st day of October, 2023;</U> <U><STRIKE>and, on a temporary basis until a more appropriate compensation
arrangement can be finalized by and between the Parties</STRIKE></U><U>, </U>the sum of Six Thousand and no/100 USD ($6,000.00) per month
starting on the 1st day of November, 2023 <U>through the 30th day of November, 2023; and the sum of Ten Thousand and no/100 USD ($10,000)
per month starting on the 1st day of December, 2023</U>, which shall be paid to MIS Consulting, Inc.; and MIS Consulting, Inc. will be
responsible for making payment to James Burgauer pursuant to whatever terms he and MIS Consulting, Inc. negotiate and determined between
themselves and without influence, input or direction in this matter by RITE.</FONT></P>

hereby amended to read as follows:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>Section
IV. ENGAGEMENT FEE AND FURTHER TERMS subsection (b) </B>RITE shall sell to James Burgauer a 5-year, assignable, non-cancellable, contractual
right to purchase one thousand, <STRIKE>two hundred and fifty (1,250)</STRIKE> <U>five hundred (1,500)</U> shares of RITE Convertible
Preferred Class C stock, at a price of <STRIKE>$200</STRIKE> <U>$120</U> per share;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.5in; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">pursuant
to both the increase in responsibilities being undertaken Mr. James Burgauer as he assumes the role of <I>acting president</I> of RITE,
and the overall decline in the price of the MineralRite Corporation stock.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>CONSULTING
AGREEMENT</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 18pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-right: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>I. THE PARTIES</B>.
This Consulting Agreement (&quot;Consulting Agreement&quot;) is made effective as of August 31, 2022, by and between:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>MIS
Consulting, Inc</B>., with a mailing address care of James Burgauer, [***] (&quot;Consulting Company&quot;); and</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>James
Burgauer</B>, with a mailing address of [***] (&quot;Designated Consultant&quot;) (collectively &quot;Consultants&quot;); and</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>Mineral
Rite Corporation, </B>with a mailing address of 539 W Commerce Street #1838, Dallas, TX 75208 (&quot;RITE&quot;), (each individually
a &quot;Party&quot; and collectively the &quot;Parties&quot;).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>II. SERVICES</B>.
Consultants agree to provide the following Services: The identification, pre-qualification, quantification, final qualification, engagement,
negotiation, contracting, and/or consummation of any and all new business opportunities, including, but not limited to, strategic relationships,
joint-ventures, acquisitions, and/or business combinations, in concert with and on behalf RITE (&quot;Services&quot;).</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>&thinsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>III. TERM</B>.
This Consulting Agreement shall commence upon execution, and shall retroactively cover the period starting on August 1, 2022 when Consultants'
services were first informally engaged, and shall continue until such time as RITE determines in its sole discretion that Consultants'
services will no longer be required; provided, however, that the minimum term of engagement shall be no less than twenty months. Subject
to the aforementioned minimum term, the Parties may terminate this Consulting Agreement on ninety (90) days' written notice. Any and
all compensation earned or being earned by Consultants' during the term of this Consulting Agreement which, for any reason, may be outstanding
or otherwise due, payable, inuring or accruing to Consultants', or, for whatever reason, be uncalculated, in process, or unpaid at the
time of termination of this Consulting Agreement, shall continue to inure to the benefit of Consultants', shall continue to be paid,
in process, due and payable in accordance with their terms of such payment, shall remain the sole property of Consultants, and shall
only be deemed fully paid when indeed they have been paid in full.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>IV. COMPENSATION</B>.
In consideration for the Services provided, Consultants are to be paid a total of three thousand and no/100 USD ($3,000.00) per month,
which shall be paid to MIS Consulting, Inc.; and MIS Consulting, Inc. will be responsible for making payment to James Burgauer pursuant
to whatever terms he and MIS Consulting, Inc. negotiate and determined between themselves and without influence, input or direction in
this matter by RITE.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0">&thinsp;</P>

METHOD</B>. Consultant shall be paid, in accordance with section IV, by any mutually acceptable electronic mean to effectuate the transfer

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>VI. ENGAGEMENT
FEE AND FURTHER TERMS.</B> As an integral component and inducement for the Parties to enter into this Consulting Agreement, Consultants
and RITE hereby further agree that:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>a.)
</B>RITE shall pay to MIS Consulting, Inc. an engagement fee of one thousand and no/100 USD ($1,000), payable promptly upon execution
of this Consulting Agreement;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>b.)
</B>RITE shall sell to James Burgauer a 5-year, assignable, non-cancellable, contractual right to purchase one thousand, two hundred
and fifty (1,250) shares of RITE Convertible Preferred Class C stock, at a price of $200 per share;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>c.)
</B>each such contractual right, as described herein, shall cost James Burgauer eighty cents USD ($0.80), such that the total sum of
all such rights being purchased and sold herein shall be the total of one thousand and no/100 USD ($1,000);</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>d.)
</B>each such share of RITE Convertible Preferred Class C, by virtue of the following additional contractual rights being purchased and
sold herein, shall allow the holder of each such share acquired under these terms, to convert said share, at holder's sole discretion
and at any time forever into the future, into no less than the equivalent of four hundred thousand (400,000) common shares of RITE as
such common shares exist at the effective date of this Consulting Agreement (as may be adjusted from time to time by any and all corporate
actions or reorganizations that RITE might undergo during the term covered by these aforementioned contractual rights);</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>e.)
</B>pursuant to the agreed upon exercise price of each such right, allowing the holder to buy each share of Convertible Preferred Class
C at a price of $200, the Parties hereby acknowledge and agree that James Burgauer shall gain no economic benefit in the purchase of
said rights since the financial value of each Convertible Preferred Class C share exactly equates to the financial value of the underlying
RITE common shares at the time this Consulting Agreement is executed (400,000 shares X $0.0005 per share = $200.00), and in fact, actually
subjects James Burgauer to the additional financial costs and risks associated with his cost to acquire such contractual rights, the
conversion thereof, and the restrictions associated therewith (including but not limited to the $1,000 cost of acquisition of the 5-year
assignable, non-cancellable contractual right of purchase being paid by James Burgauer); and</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>f.)
</B>the fee that James Burgauer is being charged for the acquisition of these rights has been negotiated in a fair and equitable manner
by the Parties and is directly related to the cost of RITE stock trading in the market at the effective date of this Consulting Agreement.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0 0 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

Consulting, Inc. and RITE further agree that the payment of Consultants' one thousand and no/100 USD ($1,000) engagement fee pursuant
to the terms</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>VII. CONTINGENCY
AND TRANSACTION FEES</B>. In addition to the compensation and engagement fee and further terms, and as a further integral component and
inducement for the Parties to enter into this Consulting Agreement, the Parties further understand and acknowledge that additional contingency-based
or transaction-based fees may be earned by Consultants during the term of this Consulting Agreement, as they may be negotiated and agreed
to by the Parties from time in the normal course of the performance of Consultants' Services, and Consultants and RITE hereby acknowledge
and agree that all such fees will be reasonable and customary and within the range of that which will be considered industry standard
for similar such transactions.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>VIII. EXPENSES</B>.
RITE shall be responsible for all pre-approved, or otherwise reasonable, normal and customary expenses related to Consultants' engagement
to provide the requested Consulting Services under this Consulting Agreement. This includes, but is not limited to, supplies, equipment,
travel, operating costs and business costs incurred in connection with the Consulting Services provided by Consultants including out-of-pocket
expenses. RITE agrees to pay Consultants within thirty (30) days of receiving notice of any expense directly associated with said Consulting
Services. Upon request by RITE, Consultants may have to show receipt(s) or proof(s) of purchase for said expense.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>&thinsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>IX. DISPUTES</B>.
If any dispute arises under this Consulting Agreement, Consultants and RITE shall negotiate in good faith to settle such dispute. If
the Parties cannot resolve such disputes themselves, then any Party may submit the dispute to mediation by a mediator approved by all
Parties. If the Parties cannot agree with any mediator or if any Party does not wish to abide by any decision of the mediator, they shall
submit the dispute to binding arbitration. The costs of the arbitration proceeding shall be borne according to the decision of the arbitrator,
who may apportion costs equally or in accordance with any finding of fault or lack of good faith of any Party.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">The Arbitration
tribunal shall be comprised of three Arbitrators, one appointed by each MIS Consulting, Inc. and RITE, and the third appointed by the
prior two arbitrators. The Arbitration shall be governed by the rules of the American Arbitration Association. English shall be the language
of the Arbitration proceedings. Exclusive venue, jurisdiction and applicable law for the Arbitration shall be governed by Sections XX
below.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: left; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif">&thinsp;</FONT></P>

and agree that evidence presented in Arbitration shall be limited in its entirety to that contained in this Agreement and a compendium
(hereinafter the &quot;Compendium&quot;) that is limited to and consists of: (i) this Agreement; (ii) banking advise of payments by the
Parties; (iii) the accounting for the specific transaction or right that relates specifically to the scope and subject matter of the
Arbitration; and such</FONT></P>

to any claims for personal injury, property damage, or infringement of copyright, patent, or other proprietary rights. RITE reserves
the right to retain whatever funds which would be due to Consultants under this Consulting Agreement until such suits, action or actions,
claim or claims for injuries or damages as aforesaid shall have been settled and satisfactory evidence to that effect furnished.</FONT></P>

This Consulting Agreement shall remain in effect in the event a section or provision is unenforceable or invalid. All remaining sections
and provisions shall be deemed legally binding unless a court administers that any such provision or section is invalid or unenforceable,
thus, limiting the effect of another provision or section. In such case, the affected provision or section shall be enforced as so limited.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>&thinsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: left; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, Sans-Serif"><B>XXII. ENTIRE
CONSULTING AGREEMENT</B>. This Consulting Agreement, along with any attachments or addendums, represents the entire Consulting Agreement
between the Parties. Therefore, this Consulting Agreement supersedes any prior Consulting Agreements, promises, conditions, or understandings
between RITE and Consultant.</FONT></P>
</DIV>
</CENTER>
